### WhistleInteraction

```ts
type WhistleInteraction = Readonly<{
  signal: AbortSignal;
  prompt: <Kind>(prompt, options?) => Promise<WhistlePromptAnswers[Kind]>;
  notify: (notice) => void;
}>;
```

A human conversation attached to one execution. `prompt` rejects when the human
cancels; `signal` aborts when the whole interaction is dismissed.

## Functions

### scopeSnapshot()

```ts
function scopeSnapshot(snapshot, scope): WhistleSnapshot;
```

The projection for one focused scope: global rows plus the focused scope's rows.
A focused slash alias or binding shadows the same global one. Agent rows follow
the same scope filter; the complete runtime remains whole.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                  | Description                                                  |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `snapshot` | [`WhistleSnapshot`](#whistlesnapshot) | A complete runtime snapshot.                                 |
| `scope`    | `string` \| `null`                    | The focused scope, or `null` when nothing scoped is focused. |

#### Returns

[`WhistleSnapshot`](#whistlesnapshot)

A frozen snapshot of globals plus the selected scope.
